attr.title: Ultionus
attr.desc: The galactic heroine Serena S and her best friend Balzac have saved the Universe again! She posts her victory on Spacebook only to be trolled by a misogynistic self proclaimed space prince. Time to make him pay! Ultionus is a love-letter to the home computer and arcade games of the late 80s and early 90s! It's kinda a spiritual successor to Phantis/Game Over II. Huge Thanks goes to Darkfalzx for making this game!
attr.inst:
[Instructions]
1) Download Legacy Version of Ultionus from itch.io (Download Ultionus_RC3D_Windows_NoSteam)
2) Drop purchased game files into the Game Data folder
3) Enjoy!!! 

[How to Play]
A = Jump
X = Shoot
